reason: New hint string is persisted in block meta.json and drives compaction segregation and inOrderBlocksMaxTime exclusion.
headline: Add from-selected-series compaction hint constant
summary: Adds the CompactionHintFromSelectedSeries value "from-selected-series", written into meta.json Compaction.Hints by CompactSelectedSeries. The planner uses it to keep selected-series blocks in their own compaction class, and inOrderBlocksMaxTime uses it to skip them, so the string becomes part of the on-disk block format.
focus: Older Prometheus/Mimir versions reading a block with this unknown hint treat it as regular, so it can count towards inOrderBlocksMaxTime after a downgrade
The string value is now a persisted on-disk format and cannot be renamed later
A block carrying both stale and selected hints is classed as stale by plan's switch; confirm that is intended
